authority.source: config/operator_directives.json@main plus latest explicit user instruction

deterministic_counterexample.interpretation: The canonical day-block statistics are identical even though case A contains one economic event repeated across days and case B contains twenty distinct events. Repeated sessions or terminal observations from one event can therefore look statistically stable without cross-event evidence.

economic_relevance: Graph/RV, Local Factor pairs and ranking relative pairs can revisit the same economic event over multiple sessions or days.
Multiple positions tied to one eventual resolution path are not independent cross-event evidence merely because they mature on different UTC days.
The current operator objective requires audited forward fill-conditioned post-cost PnL; event pseudo-replication can overstate confidence in that PnL.
required_successor: Bind every mature PnL observation to canonical event_id plus model and horizon identity.
Fail closed when economic event identity is missing or ambiguous.
Use dependence-aware inference that preserves both event clustering and chronology, such as hierarchical event-by-time or event-cluster resampling with a predeclared rule.
Require enough distinct event clusters before interpreting bootstrap or fold stability as promotion evidence.
Keep completion states and the exact same frozen trades under 1x, 1.5x and 2x cost stress.
